It's impossible to be a "35th-generation New Mexican". That would mean her ancestors have lived in New Mexico for about 1000 years, but the earliest use of any term resembling "New Mexico" for that area, or any organization of that area as a distinct geopolitical entity, was in 1581. Furthermore, even if we were simply talking about the land area before it was called that, she wouldn't have any family records from 300 years ago, let alone 1000, to prove that claim. Family folklore doesn't count.
